**v1.14.2: the quest walker talks to NPCs whose quest names it couldn't read before, such as Sir Reginald Baxby in Golem Court.**

- **Fixed: "Talking to Persona,First_... Persona,Last_... didn't work".**
  - **What was wrong:** some NPCs get their quest name from two of the game's name tables, `Persona,First` and `Persona,Last`. The comma in those table names stopped the helper from looking the names up. The goal line kept the raw keys ("Talk To Persona,First_00000025 Persona,Last_00000020 in Golem Court"), so the NPC's own "Press X to talk" prompt never matched the goal. The bot didn't press X at him, used up its 3 tries and showed "Wizard101 bot needs you". Seen on Natural Born Pyromancer on 2026-11-16.
  - **Now:** those names are read like any other: "Talk To Sir Reginald Baxby in Golem Court". The bot presses X at his prompt, OCR slips included ("SIRREGINALDBAXEY"), and still not at other NPCs' prompts near him.
- **Checked:** the real name tables give "Sir Reginald" and "Baxby". All four prompt readings from that log match him, and Hilda Brewer's doesn't. 888 of 889 vision tests pass, including 1 new one. `test_ahk_names`' speedhack path test errors, as on v1.12.0. Not tried in the game yet.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install. Your settings, learned cards, routes and recorded battles are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
